definitions.node_error: Corrected fitted path minus recorded angle at the same original source time, excluding protected nodes
definitions.local_envelope: Dense path outside the range of the two adjacent recorded samples; includes smoothing displacement, not proof of a new extremum
definitions.dense_reference: Piecewise linear connection of samples; actual inter-sample physical motion is unknown
definitions.dense_resolution: 20 subdivisions per original 30 Hz interval; numerical scan, not an analytic bound
